sections.h2: What a client case can establish

items.content: A complete recording can help confirm who performed the agreed steps, where they took place, and which items were delivered. It cannot show that later changes in income, health or family life were caused by the rite.
Providers usually choose which stories to show. A positive report, before-and-after photo or single promotion cannot establish a typical result or replace independent evidence.
Before viewing or sharing a former client’s recording, confirm the scope of their consent. Names, faces, health information and personal materials require careful handling.
Ask when and where the recording was made, who performed the service and whether a continuous record exists. An edited clip may explain a process but is weaker evidence of delivery.
A later business gain may follow a ceremony without being caused by it. Work, market conditions and chance can all contribute.
Confirm the RMB price, RMB 10,000 deposit, remaining balance, upgrade difference, recording, returned items, rescheduling and refund terms before paying.
This site does not promise wealth, promotion, medical recovery, longevity, marriage or exam results, nor a fixed response time.

items.h3: Use professional evidence for major decisions
items.content: Medical, financial, legal and career choices require relevant professional advice and verifiable facts. A cultural service cannot replace them.
